items.title: Amid Higher Gas And Grocery Prices, GTA 6 Is A "Bargain" At $80, Take-Two CEO Says
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told CNBC that $80 is a bargain for GTA 6 given its hours of gameplay, even with inflation squeezing consumers.

items.title: GTA 6 Trailer 4 Officially Released
items.summary: Rockstar released a short PS5-captured trailer with new Vice City scenes to mark the start of pre-loading.

items.title: GTA 6 won't run at 60fps even on PS5 Pro, but Sony's console does have an exclusive: ray-traced shadows and PSSR
items.summary: A Rockstar blog post confirmed a 30fps target on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PS5 Pro getting PSSR and ray-traced shadows and Xbox getting cloud play.

items.title: GTA 6 Won't Have Any Last Minute Delays, as It's Officially Gone Gold
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed on the earnings call that GTA 6 has gone gold, and told IGN there will be no further delays before the November 19 launch.

items.title: GTA 7 Won't Take as Long as GTA 6, Says Take-Two CEO
items.summary: Zelnick says future Grand Theft Auto projects should develop with greater "velocity" thanks to the groundwork laid during GTA 6's development.

items.title: GTA 6 Disc Release and PC Version Update Would Come From Rockstar, Take-Two CEO Says
items.summary: On the earnings call, Zelnick declined to give a timeline for a GTA 6 physical disc, PC version or Switch 2 version, and said any news would come from Rockstar.

items.title: 'GTA 6' Presales 'Far in Excess' of Expectations Ahead of Next Week's Launch, Take-Two CEO Says
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told Variety that GTA 6 presales are running far above expectations, and said more performance details will come after launch.

items.title: Rockstar spins the GTA 6 wheel again and lands on comically large music festival featuring Travis Scott, Cardi B, and composer Justice
items.summary: Rockstar and PlayStation announced Grand Theft Auto 6: The Festival, a two-stage Miami event on November 21 with Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin and a DJ set by Justice.

items.title: Missing Data Has GTA 6 Fans Worried It Might Be Censored In Australia And New Zealand
items.summary: Dataminers found that a small 704 KB "core" chunk is missing from the Australia and New Zealand preload metadata, which has led to speculation about regional censorship.

items.title: GTA 6 Preloading Is Officially Live, Files Mention Multiplayer And PS5 Pro Features
items.summary: Preloading opened first in Australia and New Zealand, and datamined files reference multiplayer activities, a separate Story download, and PS5 Pro 120Hz support.
